spanish: Y si debajo de ella se parare la mancha, no se extendió en piel, y ella oscura, elevación de la quemadura ella, y lo purificará el sacerdote, porque cicatriz de la quemadura ella.

findings.issue: H3544 is dim, dull, or faint; oscura resolves it as dark.
H934 names a bright spot; mancha leaves out the brightness in the lemma.
Both verbs are qal (stand; spread). The clitic se is intransitive smoothing and does not change the participants.

notes: 3fs referents, the 3ms object on purificará, the construct chains, and article-less en piel match the tokens.
